slot: Your question, plus the daily report
summary: The S&P 500 closed at 7,743.41, up 0.51% today, driven largely by hopes that the US and Iran are moving toward a deal that could reopen the Strait of Hormuz shipping lane. That sent oil down 2.46% to 92.28 dollars a barrel, which is good for consumers and businesses that depend on fuel costs staying manageable. Gold rose 0.65% to 4,326.00 and silver jumped 2.06%, both acting as stores of value while bond yields remain elevated at 5.18% on the 10 year US Treasury. Next week brings Micron earnings on September 30, which matters directly to your portfolio.
